an7.10:2.3: uggaṁ saṁyojanañceva → uggaṁsaññojanaṁceva (bj) | uggaṁ saṁyojanañceva pahānaṁ macchariyena → uggasaññojanañceva pahānamacchariyena (sya-all)
an7.10:2.4:
macchariyenacā’ti → dve piyadve bala dhanaṁ asaññī me saṅkhittañceva vitthataṁ. 
uggasaññojanaṁ ceva pahānamacchariyena cā’ti – sīmu (bj note)
